text: Sorry if this is a daft thing to be ringing about at this hour. I'm minding my grandson, he's 4 months, and his temperature has just come up 39.8. I think it might be his teeth because he's dribbling everywhere, chewing on anything he can get hold of and one cheek is all red. His nappies are wet same as always and his breathing is fine, I've been watching him. Is 39.8 too high for a baby that small, or am I fussing over nothing? I don't want to waste anybody's time.
